movies.title: OG
movies.description: The story follows Ojas Gambheera (played by Pawan Kalyan), a legendary mob boss and highly skilled martial artist. After living in exile and training in Japan for a decade, he returns to the gritty underworld of 1993 Mumbai. He resurfaces to protect his former mentor, defend his community, and wage a high-stakes war against Omi Bhau (Emraan Hashmi), a ruthless crime lord vying for dominance over the city's ports.

movies.title: Indra
movies.description: The story follows Indrasena Reddy (played by Chiranjeevi), a noble man who tries to resolve a violent, generational water dispute between rival clans in the Rayalaseema region. After sacrificing his wealth and land for peace, he is forced into exile and lives as a humble taxi driver in Varanasi under an alias, until his past catches up with him and he must return to protect his people.
